name: Linear Spline Simplification
definition: An iterative algorithm to reduce knot count by merging consecutive spline segments if internal knots lie within a pre-chosen vertical distance (scalar domain) from the candidate merged segment.
summary: Linear Spline Simplification is an iterative knot removal algorithm that reduces control points in 1D splines by merging segments when internal knots lie within a specified vertical distance from the candidate merged segment.
